تنتشقين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِقِينَ (tantašiqīna) /tan.ta.ʃi.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
# تُنْتَشَقِينَ (tuntašaqīna) /tun.ta.ʃa.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
